provenance.asset_description: Two images overlayed over a blurred background, in the top left corner is the Glorious Payoff, a three-masted galleon sails the open seas, its sails all marked with the Glyph of the Open Road. In the bottom right corner is Calisro Benarry, a green skinned, dromaar woman in clothing that clearly marks her as a ship’s captain. She is looking towards the horizon, considering her future.
